The supplied material does not identify the exact reference point on the bottle, so try to move the entire bottle into the right-hand area and well clear of the table.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping a relatively straight section of the bottle with little change in thickness, avoiding the cap, shoulder, and uneven base. Orient the gripper’s closing direction close to perpendicular to the bottle’s long axis.
- Use small movements near the table and close only after confirming the selected bottle section is within the effective contact area between the pads, reducing empty grasps or pushing the bottle away.
- Lift slightly after closing and check whether the bottle moves with the gripper. Carry it to the right only after confirming the grasp, leaving clearance from objects on the table.
